title: Long-Term Visual and Refractive Stability and Ocular Biometric Changes after Laser-Assisted Subepithelial Keratomileusis for Correction of Myopia: An 8-Year Follow-Up

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <permissions>/<license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License); private: record not published

indication: mild to moderate myopia with or without astigmatism (inclusion limits as stated in Methods)

groups.description: LASEK (20% alcohol, epithelial flap, Technolas 217P excimer, 6.5 mm optical zone) with mitomycin C 0.02% and bandage lens; both eyes of 35 patients who completed the 6-month and 8-year visits; prospective, single surgeon

series.notes: mean (SD) columns only (Table 1 'Mean (SD)' under baseline, 6 months and 8 years); the same 70 eyes at every visit (completers)

exclusions.reason: generalized mixed-model fixed-effect estimates are model-adjusted estimates, not admissible

exclusions.what: Figures 1-3 (cumulative CDVA/UDVA and change in CDVA)
exclusions.reason: visual acuity, not refraction; figures are not citable cells

notes: Target refraction is not stated; recorded as unstated.
Method: manifest refraction (Abstract and Methods: manifest refractions assessed preoperatively, at 6 months and 8 years; cycloplegic refraction mentioned only as part of the examination).

Analysis set: 90 patients were enrolled; 35 patients (70 eyes) completed both follow-ups and Methods exclude participants with follow-up shorter than 8 years, so every visit reports the same completers; the selection is by follow-up completion, not by a refractive outcome (kept as attrition, with this note).
Both eyes of each patient included (laterality handled as a repeated measure in the authors' model).
Table 1 also tabulates sphere, cylinder, keratometry, CCT, axial length, anterior chamber and aqueous depth and lens thickness (not extracted; schema 1.0.0 has no such series).
